title: Seven Nation Army
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Learn one of rock's most famous riffs using a single string, plus how to keep a steady, punchy rhythm.
focus: Find the riff on the A string and learn its note order and rhythm.

title: Smoke on the Water
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play the classic two-note riff and get comfortable moving a simple shape up and down the neck.
focus: Learn the riff as two-string shapes on the lower strings.

title: A Horse with No Name
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Strum a two-chord song and learn to switch between two easy chord shapes in time.
focus: Learn the two chord shapes and practise switching between them.

title: (I Can't Get No) Satisfaction
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Practise a bouncy single-note riff with hammer-ons and a simple rhythm part for the verses.
focus: Learn the main riff on its own, one phrase at a time.

title: Iron Man
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Get to know heavy power chords and slow, deliberate timing with slides between chords.
focus: Learn the power chord shapes and the slides between them.

title: Song 2
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Switch between a clean, quiet riff and loud, driving power chords with sharp stops.
focus: Learn the quiet riff and the loud power chords as two separate parts.

title: Brain Stew
tuning: Half step down (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
description: Build speed and stamina with a repeating power-chord riff and tight palm muting.
focus: Tune down a half step, then learn the riff in short two-beat pieces.

title: Hey Brother
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a folk-style strumming pattern with open chords and a steady driving rhythm.
focus: Learn the chords of the verse and chorus.

title: Riptide
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Strum a bouncy, syncopated pattern with three simple chords.
focus: Learn the three chords and the strumming pattern.

title: Stand by Me
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a classic four-chord loop and practise the famous walking bass-style rhythm.
focus: Learn the four chords and the order they repeat in.

title: Bad Moon Rising
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Practise a bouncing country-rock strum with three open chords and quick changes.
focus: Learn the three chords and the bouncing strum.

title: Take Me Home, Country Roads
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Strum a gentle folk song with open chords and add small bass-note runs between chord changes.
focus: Learn the open chords and the order of the verse and chorus.

title: Ring of Fire
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a three-chord country song with a driving boom-chicka strum.
focus: Learn the three chords and practise changing between them.

title: Come As You Are
tuning: Half step down (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
description: Play a watery single-note riff and learn how a chorus effect changes the sound of simple notes.
focus: Tune down a half step, then learn the riff note by note.

title: You Really Got Me
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Practise sliding power chords with a snappy, driving rhythm.
focus: Learn the two power chord shapes and the slide between them.

title: Zombie
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Strum a four-chord loop and learn to change chords in time while keeping a steady pattern.
focus: Learn the four chords and practise changing between them.

title: Boulevard of Broken Dreams
tuning: Half step down (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
description: Combine open chords with a slow strumming pattern and a short, simple lead line.
focus: Tune down a half step, then learn the chord progression.

title: I'm Yours
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Combine four open chords with a relaxed, bouncy strumming pattern.
focus: Learn the four chords and the order they repeat in.

title: Let It Be
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a slow four-chord progression and learn to keep the beat steady while changing chords.
focus: Learn the chord shapes and the order of the verse.

title: Wish You Were Here
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Practise a simple picked intro and gentle open-chord strumming.
focus: Learn the intro pattern by itself, slowly.

title: Free Fallin'
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Use a capo, if you like, and play with a loose, steady strumming feel.
focus: Learn the chords and the simple strum.

title: The Joker
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Combine open chords with a bluesy, laid-back strum and a short bass line.
focus: Learn the chords and the relaxed strum.

title: What's Up?
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Strum a four-chord loop that builds from soft to loud, with steady chord changes.
focus: Learn the four chords and the chord-change order.

title: Hallelujah
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a gentle waltz rhythm (three beats per bar) with a simple picking pattern.
focus: Learn the chords and the three-beat strum.

title: Wonderwall
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Practise a classic strumming pattern with a capo and four chords that keep their fingers anchored.
focus: Put the capo on the 2nd fret and learn the four chord shapes.

title: Another One Bites the Dust
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a tight, funky one-string riff and practise leaving silences between the notes.
focus: Learn the riff note order, then practise the gaps between the notes.

title: Creep
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Learn four chords including barre-style shapes, plus loud/quiet dynamics with the crunchy stabs.
focus: Learn the four chord shapes, starting with the easiest versions.

title: Sunshine of Your Love
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a bluesy, repeating riff and learn how to let notes ring and stop with the right timing.
focus: Learn the riff in two halves, then join them together.

title: Come Together
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Practise a slow, swampy groove with a simple riff and short chord stabs.
focus: Learn the main riff and the chords of the verse.

title: House of the Rising Sun
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Learn arpeggios (picking the notes of a chord one by one) with six open chords.
focus: Learn the chord shapes and the picking pattern for one chord.

title: Californication
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a moody chord progression with a clean, steady strum and some barre chords.
focus: Learn the four chords and the strum pattern.

title: Nothing Else Matters
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a picked intro using open strings and learn to move into gentle chord changes.
focus: Learn the picked intro slowly, one bar at a time.

title: Highway to Hell
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Strum open chords with a punchy, rock rhythm and clean muting.
focus: Learn the chord shapes and the punchy strum pattern.

title: Last Nite
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play two interlocking guitar parts and a steady down-picked rhythm.
focus: Learn the main riff first; add the second part later.

title: Are You Gonna Be My Girl
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Work on a fast, raw garage-rock riff and tight, energetic chord strumming.
focus: Learn the intro riff in small phrases.

title: Back in Black
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Combine open chords with muted strums, and learn the swing of AC/DC's rhythm style.
focus: Learn the chord shapes and the muted strum pattern.

title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
tuning: Half step down (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
description: Move power chords smoothly, change between loud and quiet sections, and play a catchy melodic riff.
focus: Tune down a half step, then learn the main riff and chord order.

title: Day Tripper
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Play a bluesy riff built from two strings and practise changing to dominant 7th chords.
focus: Learn the opening riff, then the chord changes.

title: The Man Who Sold the World
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Combine a repeating riff with open chords and a moody, steady rhythm.
focus: Learn the opening riff by itself, slowly.

title: Whole Lotta Love
tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
description: Tackle a heavy, bluesy riff with bends and a loose rhythm that rewards listening closely.
focus: Learn the riff note by note, with extra attention to the timing.
